clue.text: A sinful desire of one mind

parts.note: greed, avarice, is one of the seven deadly sins

explanation.surface: Covetousness is apparently something a whole group can share in unison.
explanation.definitionFit: People of one mind concur, having reached the same view on a matter.

clue.text: Value a quiet compliment

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
praise is a compliment

explanation.surface: Valuing a muted word of approval.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess the worth of something is to value it, as an estate agent does.

clue.text: Terrible female removed from top position, as is proper

indicators.note: the letter is taken off the front, the top of a down entry

parts.note: frightful means terrible

explanation.surface: A dreadful woman is ousted from the top job, quite properly.
explanation.definitionFit: Legitimate and justified, as a lawful heir or one's due is.

clue.text: Objects to extremes

definitions.meaning: the furthest points at either side

explanation.surface: Someone protests against excess.
explanation.definitionFit: Means to an aim are its goals, and the tips of a rope are its extremities.

clue.text: Film plot thus includes a rewrite of Racine

indicators.note: the word for thus holds the other piece within it

parts.note: thus and so both mean in this way

indicators.note: a rewrite reworks the French dramatist's name into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A screenwriter adapts a play by the French tragedian Racine for the cinema.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Film plot' reads as part of the story about adapting Racine, but it is the definition; 'a' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A scenario is the outline or script of a film, setting out its storyline.

clue.text: Athletics event, coast-to-coast — in Malta?

definitions.meaning: a running race over open country
going right across a land from one side to the other
Malta was awarded the George Cross in 1942, so is the country of the Cross

explanation.surface: An athletics race run from one shore to the other on the island of Malta.
explanation.walkthrough: Malta holds the George Cross, Britain's top civilian award for bravery, and shows it on its flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A long run over fields and hills is the race; spanning a nation is the adverb; Malta is jokingly the nation with a cross.

clue.text: A file may be needed on this arrest

definitions.text: A file may be needed on this
definitions.meaning: a fingertip covering that a manicurist shapes with an emery board
to catch and detain a criminal, slang for collar

explanation.surface: A prisoner may need a smuggled file to escape after being nabbed.
explanation.definitionFit: The fingertip plate is filed smooth, and police slang for catching a villain is the same word.

clue.text: Endlessly producing fruit

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: raising, as raising crops, is producing

explanation.surface: A farm that never stops growing fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A dried grape is a fruit, eaten as a snack or baked in cakes.

clue.text: Seas, as once ranged around

indicators.note: the letters roam about into another order

explanation.surface: Seas, as once they roamed round the world.
explanation.definitionFit: The great bodies of salt water covering the globe are its main seas.

clue.text: Temple of a deity in Pennsylvania

indicators.note: the deity phrase sits inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Pennsylvania
a deity is a god

explanation.surface: A shrine to some god stands somewhere in Pennsylvania.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered tower serving as a Buddhist or Hindu shrine in Asia.

clue.text: Certain kind of proof produced by a photographer

definitions.meaning: sure, with no doubt at all

definitions.text: kind of proof produced by a photographer
definitions.meaning: a print made from a negative, a photographic proof showing true tones

explanation.surface: A particular sort of trial print comes out of a photographer's darkroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sure of something is being confident; and in photography a print with true light and dark is so named.

clue.text: Receive satisfaction from providing quarters for lions?

definitions.meaning: to feel pleased with or proud of something
a pride is a group of lions, so accommodating one would be housing them

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys running a lion enclosure at the zoo.
explanation.definitionFit: To be proud of one's work is the idiom; literally, lodging a pride means housing a group of lions.

clue.text: Social worker takes one to be an opponent

parts.note: an ant is a social insect, and a worker ant is the crossword's favourite labourer
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A social worker, perhaps in a care case, sets someone up as an adversary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' suggests a welfare officer, but it is an insect from a colony.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is against a cause is a person opposed to it, used as a noun.

clue.text: Flower that's fresh, comparatively speaking

parts.note: the simile 'as fresh as a ...' names this blossom as the standard of freshness

explanation.surface: A bloom picked out for being particularly fresh in comparison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comparatively speaking' points to the idiom comparing someone's freshness to this flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The common white-petalled meadow bloom features in the saying used of a lively, rested person.

clue.text: The hot pot maker

parts.note: an oven in which pottery is fired at high temperature, so it is a hot maker of pots

explanation.surface: Reads like a cook famous for hotpot, the Lancashire stew.
explanation.walkthrough: Hotpot is a Lancashire stew of lamb and sliced potato, but here the pot is ceramic and the heat is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: A potter's furnace bakes clay vessels hard, making the finished ware.

clue.text: It isn't true it comes to a moral conclusion

definitions.text: It isn't true it comes to a moral conclusion

parts.words: It isn't true it comes to a moral conclusion
parts.note: a made-up story, as by Aesop, that ends with a lesson

explanation.walkthrough: Aesop's tales are invented and close with 'the moral is...'.
explanation.definitionFit: A short tale, often of animals, told to teach a lesson set out at its end.

clue.text: Student appearing in report to prosper

indicators.note: the student's letter shows up within the noise

parts.note: a boom is a loud report, like a bang
L is the learner plate on a British student driver's car

explanation.surface: A pupil turning up in a school report as thriving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'report' looks like a school document, but it is a loud bang.
explanation.definitionFit: To flourish or thrive, as a flower does at its peak.

clue.text: Party fare provided by wise man going round America with car

indicators.note: the wise man's letters are placed around the country

parts.note: a sage is a wise person
USA, the United States of America
a Rolls, short for Rolls-Royce, the luxury car

explanation.surface: A sage tours the States by car, keeping the party supplied.
explanation.walkthrough: These pastry-wrapped snacks are a British party staple.
explanation.definitionFit: Small pastry snacks with meat filling are classic buffet food at gatherings.

clue.text: Check when others will take a shower

parts.note: the rest are the others
a shower of rain

explanation.surface: Checking when the rest of the group will wash.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold back or curb something is to check it.

clue.text: First love found by girl in a novel

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters take a new form

explanation.surface: A first romance discovered by a heroine in a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book, but signals rearranging GIRLINA into RIGINAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The first version, from which copies are made, is the earliest.

clue.text: Get dressed and prepare to go on a drive?

definitions.meaning: to put on one's clothing, gear being clothes

definitions.text: prepare to go on a drive?
definitions.meaning: a driver engages a gear on the gearbox before moving off

explanation.surface: Someone dresses and gets ready for an outing in the car.
explanation.definitionFit: Gear means both clothing and a gearbox setting, so the phrase means donning clothes or engaging a gear.

clue.text: Language curve takes a big cut

indicators.note: the curve holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: an arc is a curve

indicators.note: the word is cut short, losing its end

explanation.surface: A curved line in a language takes a big cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' removes the final letter of 'big', and 'takes' means the curve swallows the 'a' plus that shortened word.
explanation.definitionFit: The Semitic tongue of North Africa and the Middle East is a language.

clue.text: Naturalist in ward for treatment

indicators.note: the letters undergo treatment, being processed into a new order

explanation.surface: A naturalist taken into a hospital ward to be treated.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Darwin was the Victorian naturalist behind the theory of evolution.

clue.text: New pear harvest

indicators.note: a new version of the word, its letters made over afresh

explanation.surface: Gathering the season's fresh crop of pears.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather in a crop is a synonym, the farmer's act of cutting grain.

clue.text: In decimal it represents one cubic decimetre

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A statement about the metric system: what a decimal unit stands for.
explanation.definitionFit: The metric unit of volume equals a thousand cubic centimetres, a cube ten centimetres a side.

clue.text: One who speculates in shares unsuitable for women

definitions.meaning: a buyer of new issues who sells at once for a quick profit
describing a men-only event, such as a bachelor party

explanation.surface: A warning that share speculation is no game for women.
explanation.walkthrough: A stag night is the British all-male party before a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: In stock-market slang the word names a quick-profit applicant, and as an adjective it means men only.

clue.text: Very very fair

parts.note: so means very, as in so good
so again means very

explanation.surface: Something extremely fair, as of complexion or weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Middling or mediocre is the sense of fair as in fair to middling.

clue.text: Wear down in fight

definitions.meaning: to unravel at the edge through rubbing

explanation.surface: Someone is worn out in a brawl.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloth edges unravel with wear, and a scuffle is the same word as a noun.

clue.text: Surprise an enthusiastic archer?

definitions.meaning: someone fond of the archer's weapon, a fan of the longbow

explanation.surface: Amazing a keen bowman, perhaps with a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: To astonish is the idiom's sense; read as words, the phrase names a fan of archery's weapon.

clue.text: Consecrate Rodin works around area

indicators.note: the reworked name goes around the single letter
the sculptor's name is worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: Blessing the sculptures of Rodin in some district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'works' makes ORDIN from RODIN, and 'around' puts it about A.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit someone formally to holy orders is to make them a priest by sacred rite.

clue.text: Swindle brought to light in defeat

parts.note: a con is a trick or swindle
found means discovered

explanation.surface: A fraud is exposed, ending in the swindler's downfall.
explanation.definitionFit: To thwart or overthrow plans or enemies is an older sense, as in 'confound their politics'.

clue.text: Volume of praise

parts.note: a book of songs sung in worship, as in a church

explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' hints at loudness, but it is a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A church book of hymns collects songs that glorify God.
